questions.question: It was not until I had finished my degree that I realized the importance of developing a strong professional network.
options: I didn't realize the importance of networking until after finishing university.
Only after completing my studies did it become clear to me how crucial networking is.
It wasn't until I graduated from college that I understood the significance of building relationships in the workplace.
It was only when I finished my education that I began to appreciate the value of having a professional network.
questions.answer: I didn't realize the importance of networking until after finishing university.

questions.question: By the time the new policy had been implemented, it was already clear that many employees were struggling to adapt.
options: When the new policy came into effect, it became apparent that staff members were finding it difficult to adjust.
The introduction of the new policy revealed that many workers were having trouble adapting to the changes.
It soon became evident that employees were facing significant challenges in adjusting to the new rules.
As soon as the new policy was put into place, it became clear that staff members were struggling with its implementation.
questions.answer: When the new policy came into effect, it became apparent that staff members were finding it difficult to adjust.

questions.question: Had I known about the job opportunity in advance, I would have applied immediately.
options: If I had been aware of the job opening earlier, I would have submitted my application right away.
Given that I was aware of the job opportunity ahead of time, I applied as soon as possible.
Knowing about the job in advance allowed me to apply promptly.
Since I was informed about the job early on, I applied without delay.
questions.answer: If I had been aware of the job opening earlier, I would have submitted my application right away.

questions.question: The company's decision to invest in renewable energy was motivated by a desire to reduce its carbon footprint.
options: It is the company's intention to decrease its environmental impact by investing in green technologies.
The primary reason for the company's investment in renewable energy sources is to minimize waste and pollution.
The decision to invest in solar panels was driven by a need to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
The main goal of the company's investment in wind power is to decrease its reliance on fossil fuels.
questions.answer: It is the company's intention to decrease its environmental impact by investing in green technologies.

questions.question: Were it not for my friend's recommendation, I would never have applied for the job.
options: If it hadn't been for my friend's advice, I wouldn't have submitted my application.
My friend's suggestion led me to apply for the position, which otherwise might not have occurred.
The fact that my friend recommended me for the job made all the difference in my decision to apply.
It was only because of my friend's endorsement that I felt confident enough to apply.
questions.answer: If it hadn't been for my friend's advice, I wouldn't have submitted my application.
